title: Podium
statement:
The race is over. You get the drivers' names and the time each of them needed to finish the race, in the same order. The **smaller** the time, the better.

The three fastest drivers stand on the podium: `P1` is the winner (smallest time), then `P2`, then `P3`.

If fewer than three drivers took part, print `not enough drivers` instead.
input_format:
Line 1: driver names separated by spaces.
Line 2: the same number of integers: each driver's race time in seconds, in the same order. All times are different.
output_format: Three lines: `P1 name`, `P2 name`, `P3 name`. Or the single line `not enough drivers`.

examples.explanation: Malika (5398) is fastest, then Dilnoza (5402), then Aziz (5420).
examples.output:
P1 Malika
P2 Dilnoza
P3 Aziz
